description: Create a customer with only what's needed: a name, and an email if the merchant gives one. Refuses a likely duplicate (same name or email) and lists it instead; pass confirm_new only after the merchant confirms it's a different customer.

confirm_new.description: true only after the merchant confirmed that a listed possible duplicate is a different customer.

create_another.description: true only when the merchant deliberately wants a second record identical to one just created (e.g. two identical sales). Never to retry an error.

email.description: Optional email, only if the merchant gave it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, advanced: your own key for this exact request. Leave it out normally: a retry of an unresolved request is resumed automatically.

name.description: The customer's or company's name, as the merchant said it.

name: create_customer
title: Create customer
